name: Dyrades Musume
source:
The ruler of Dungeon 3.

Seems a bit off at first glance, but is diligent and fundamentally kind. She's been bothered by her long drought of male attention.

Having served the previous king in the past, she's also acquainted with the maid, Rumi.

[From [url=https://fandc.co.jp/dragonsraid3/charactor05.html]Official website[/url]]
